NER/RPC/9001-0723 Name of package: AMC of Split/Window and Tower type Air Conditioners installed at GI S Hall, IOTL, Admin Office, Transit Camp, Community Centre, Battery Room and Control Room of 400/220 kV Misa Substation for a period of 02 years Scope of Work: ‘AMC of Split/Window and Tower type Air Conditioners installed at GIS H all, IOTL, Admin Office, Transit Camp, Community Centre, Battery Room and Control Ro om of 400/220 kV Misa Substation for a period of 02 years’ as per details, terms and condit ions indicated in the bidding documents. The detailed scope work shall be as per ‘Bid Specific Addi tional Terms and Conditions (ATC)’ and as per instruction of Engineer/Officer-In-Charge and other relevant Clauses of the tender documents. 1. The bidder must be a ‘Class-I local supplier’ as defined under Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order as per bidding documents. Firms who are not ‘Class-I local supplier shall n ot be eligible to bid. Presently, the local content requirement to categorize a supplier as ‘Class-I local supplier’ is minimum 60%. The ‘Class-I local supplier’ shall give a se lf-certification in his bid in the given format, indicating the percentage of Local Content a nd certifying that the item offered meets the Local Content requirement for ‘Class –I local suppli er’ and shall give details of the location(s) at which value addition is made. 2. It is the Employer’s (POWERGRID’s) policy that requires the bidder to sign a declarat ion along with its bid about abiding by a ‘Code of Integrity for Public Procurement’. A ll bidders are required to submit the same as a part of their technical bid. This policy i s detailed in the bidding documents. 3. Bid Specific Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC), Bid Forms and Qualification Req uirements against this tender package is enclosed as “Buyer uploaded ATC documen t” to this bid document. Bidder shall ensure to submit an acceptable Bid Security/EMD, mandatorily submit al l documents in support of Qualification Requirements and all the Bid Forms duly fille d, signed, completed and submit the same as a part of their technical bid. 4. Bidders shall consider the following vintage details of the Air Conditioners (ACs) while quoting t heir rates. The details provided herein shall prevail over any corresponding clause, specification

, parameter, or description mentioned in the GeM Bid document in case of any discrepancy. Sl. N Capacity Quantity Vintage o 1 4.0 TR Tower Type AC 15 15 1-2 Years (Installed during Sept-2025) 2 2.0 TR Split/Window AC 19 5-7 Years 3 1.5 TR Split/Window AC 50 5-7 Years 4 1.0 TR Split/Window AC 13 5-7 Years 5. Contract Period: The contract may be extended for a further period of up to one (01) year on the same rates, terms and conditions, subject to satisfactory performance of the contractor, mu tual consent of both parties, and approval of the Competent Authority. 6. The AMC shall be a Comprehensive AMC, covering routine maintenance, preventive maintenanc e, breakdown maintenance, consumables, gas charging/top-up, and replacement/repair activiti es as specified in the Scope of Work and STC. 7. The provision for physical inspection/site visit prior to bid closure is "Not Mandatory (NA)." How ever, prospective bidders may visit the site at their own cost before submission of bids to famili arize themselves with the site conditions and scope of work. 8. Any other applicable GeM parameter not specifically covered above may be considered in line with the approved Scope of Work (SOW) and STC 9. Site information: It is imperative for bidder to satisfy himself completely of all local conditions. In addition, the Bidder are expected to assess any problems relating to t he means of access to the site, the accommodation they may require and its availabi lity, besides any other aspects including financial implication affecting the execution of the contract covered under these documents and specifications. A Bidder shall be deemed to have full knowledge of the site (whether he inspects or not) and no claim whatsoever on this account at any stage shall be entertained. Submission of Bid by a Bidder implies that he has read this notice and all other Tender Documents and has made himself aware of the scope and specifications of the work to be done and of co nditions as well as of local conditions and other factors which may have bearing on t he execution of the works. 10. CPG/Security Deposit (SD): As a security towards satisfactory performance of the C ontract, the successful Bidder, to whom the work is awarded, shall be required to fu rnish a Performance Guarantee in favour of the Owner within 28 days from the date of Contract order. As an alternate option to CPG, pro-rata deduction as @5% from the bills of the contr actor, up-to 5% of the total contract value, shall be made towards Security Deposit i n lieu of PBG; for which contractor shall confirm either of the options. In case of any amendment to the contract, the Contract price, as amended, shall be the reference price for determining the value of Performance Guarantee/Security De posit. The contractor shall accordingly, increase/decrease the Bank Guarantee/Securi ty Deposit value submitted towards Contract Performance Guarantee based on the a mended contract value. Security Deposit shall be returned to the Contractor on succ essful completion of the works under the Contract after 90-Ninety days of end of the

contract validity period. No interest shall be pay able to the Contractor against Secu rity Deposit. 11. Issuing Banks: The Bank Guarantee for Performance Security are to be provided by the Service Provider which should be issued either by a Public Sector Bank located in India, or a scheduled Indian Bank having pa id up capital (net of any accumulated los ses) of Rs. 1,000 million or above (the latest annual report of the Bank should suppo rt compliance of capital adequacy ratio requirement) as per List of Banks enclosed. 12. "While executing the contract, the contractor shall stand comply with all requireme nts of Social Accountability Standards i.e. SA8000 (latest Standard available at www .sa-intl.org) and maintain the necessary records." 13. POWERGRID Whistle Blower and Fraud Prevention Policy: The Contractor along with its associate/ collaborators/ sub-contractors/ sub-vendors/consultants/ service provid ers shall strictly adhere to the Whistle Blower and Fraud Prevention Policy of Employ er displayed on its tender website https://apps.powergrid.in/pgciltenders/u/default.a spx and https://www.powergrid.in /index.php/en /code- conductpolicies The Contractor along with their associate / collaborator / subcontractors / sub- vendors / consultants / service providers shall observe the highest standard of ethics and shall not indulge or allow anybody else working in their organization to indulge i n fraudulent activities during execution of the contract. The contractor shall immedi ately apprise the Employer about any fraud or suspected fraud as soon as it comes t o their no tice. 14. Bidder shall comply with all terms and conditions as detailed in the bidding documents. Bids n ot conforming to this requirement are liable to be rejected. 15. Bidders may note that the Owner (POWERGRID) has uploaded its ‘Works & Procurement Policy and Procedure’: Vol-I &Vol-II to POWERGRID’s website. Those bidders who wish to peruse the sa me may visit www.powergrid.in. However, it shall be noted that no other party, including the Bi dder/ Contractor, shall derive any right from this ‘Works & Procurement Policy and Procedure’ d ocuments or have any claim on the Owner on the basis of the same. The respective rights of Ow ner and Bidders/ Contractors shall be governed by the bidding documents/ contracts signed bet ween the Owner and the Contractor for the package. The provisions of bidding documents shall always prevail over that of ‘Works & Procurement Policy and Procedure’ documents. 16. If a bid is not substantially responsive, it will be rejected by POWERGRID, and may not subsequ ently be made responsive by the Bidder by correction of the nonconformity. POWERGRID’s dete rmination of a bid’s responsiveness is to be based on the contents of the bid itself without recourse to extrinsic evidence. . 2.
